title: Man found dead in jail cell was Penticton man, 44
article: A 44-year-old Penticton resident has been identified as the man who died in Kamloops hospital after being arrested by the RCMP more than a week ago.

Stanley Steven Cardinal died last Tuesday at Royal Inland Hospital. He was arrested over the B.C. Day long weekend and was in a cell for about 12 hours before he was found unresponsive and taken to hospital. The cause of death has not yet been released.
